title: API memory limit too low
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the API container, memory OOM due to lowered limit.
root_cause: The API container is killed by the OOM killer because its memory limit was reduced to 150 MiB, which is insufficient for its workload, causing repeated restarts.
truth: Someone lowered the api container's memory limit from 512MiB to 150MiB, below its normal working set of ~180MiB, so the kernel OOM killer repeatedly terminates it (exit code 137).
check_first: docker logs <api_container_name> (or the container's log output in your monitoring tool)
